description: This file contains functions related to setting up print templates and formatting columns within a print layout, likely for an ERP or document rendering system. It specifically manages how items and taxes are displayed when printing, including handling compact item displays and hiding certain fields.

methods.name: set_print_templates_for_item_table(doc, settings)
methods.description: Configures print templates and field visibility for item tables; also sets formatting for compact print options.

methods.name: set_print_templates_for_taxes(doc, settings)
methods.description: Configures print templates related to taxes and total calculations, and determines inclusion of inclusive taxes.

methods.name: format_columns(display_columns, compact_fields)
methods.description: Filters display columns to include only those not in the compact fields, adding extra image and item info columns.
